options.name: device
options.description: Path to the block device to manage.

options.name: force
options.description: Force the operation. When O(state=present) (creating a PV), this uses C(pvcreate -f) to force creation. When O(state=absent) (removing a PV), this uses C(pvremove -ff) to force removal even if part of a volume group.

options.name: resize
options.description: Resize PV to device size when O(state=present).

options.name: state
options.description: Control if the physical volume exists.
